name: Garlic & Rosemary-Marinated Lamb Sirloin with Potato Gratin ('Til We Meet Again)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · 'Til We Meet Again Menu
whyItWorks: Lean sirloin cut of lamb with soft baked potato gratin; ask for plain mashed potatoes if leek/onion in the gratin triggers FODMAPs.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare with sun-dried tomato jus on the side and swap the onion-leek potato gratin for plain baked or mashed potatoes if FODMAP-sensitive.
watchOuts: Onion and leek layers in the standard potato gratin
